why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Sign up as a Horus tester Open the Horus sign-up page linked from the NuLink homepage banner and register as a tester.
2 Step 2 : Claim test tokens from the faucet Use the faucet in the NuLink dashboard to claim tBNB and tNLK, the two test tokens the docs say are needed for staking on the testnet.
3 Step 3 : Stake tNLK in the staking dashboard Stake your test tokens through the NuLink Staking Dashboard . The docs set a minimum stake of 1 TNLK.

4 Step 4 : Deploy and monitor a worker node Install a worker node with the NuLink Worker Installer described in the testnet docs , on a system that meets the minimum requirements the docs list, then check its status in the dashboard.
5 Step 5 : Try the demonstration DApps Test the secure file transfer demo or the NuLink Snaps showcase described in the docs, or use the NuLink Agent .
